resources.string: At the end of a Deep search the AI grades the 20 best passages; its grade is combined with the local order. Sends the query and these passages (with a little context) to the provider of the news summaries; at most 40 requests a day, answers are reused.
Your ratings of hits slightly shift how full text, meaning and title count per kind of query, and the cut-off of the meaning search. Bounded, fades over a month, stays on the phone.

How the JSON file looks and what is measured

A JSON file with your own, checked examples:

{"name": "My examples", "toleranceMs": 3000, "examples": [
 {"query": "\"exactly this sentence\"", "videoId": "dQw4w9WgXcQ", "startMs": 61000, "endMs": 68000, "kind": "quote"},
 {"query": "Why does coffee keep you awake?", "videoId": "https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ", "start": "2:05", "end": "2:20", "kind": "question"}
]}

• query: the search as you would type it
• videoId: the video id or a YouTube link
• startMs / endMs: where the right place begins and ends, in milliseconds (or start / end in seconds or as "m:ss")
• kind: "quote" or "question"; "none" = no match expected (no videoId needed)
• toleranceMs (optional, default 3000): how far off a hit may be

A hit is right when it is in the expected video and its time lies in the place ± the tolerance, or its checked borders overlap the place. Measured: Recall@1/3/5, nDCG@5, play start deviation (P50/P95), share without any hit and search time (P50/P95), each for SSI-2 and the SSI-1 way. Videos not in the index are read before the run.
